title: Project Vinland
tagline: A metaverse to onboard next wave of users into crypto and DeFi
description:
We aim to create an onchain multichain metaverse game in which users, when signed in by
their Metamask/wallet .
● They can tour the DeFi metaverse which has multiple stores/avenues like Aave and
Sushi to make transactions.
● This gamified visual experience will allow new users to better comprehend the difference
between these dapps and their IRL counterparts.
● Like AAVE -> Bank and Uniswap -> Binance/CEX
We have also created a NFT museum ,where users can go and view their NFTs in full glory in a 3D space .
Users can also mint in-game assets,(gun skins ) which are hosted on he decentralized IPFS layer .
We have also integrated a streaming space in the world ,where players can go and watch decentralized live streaming via Livepeer in the space .
how_its_made:
Project Vinland is built on Unity frontend, using ChainSafe web3 APIs to interact with the Ethereum and Polygon blockchains and languages like C#, Solidity and Blendr. We used AAVE and uniswap's smart contracts to try and implement their defi functionality in-game. 

We integrated a NFT museum , integrated with help of nftport APIs .

For minting ingame nfts we are hosting assets at IPFS .

For controlling weather conditions we have used covalent volatility APIs .

We have also integrated a streaming space in the world using livepeer . 

Although it was challenging implementing logic in C# , we are pleased with the progress and learning.
